evidence.source: CUHK Humanum 漢語多功能字庫
evidence.text: Sun-plus-moon occurs in oracle-bone and bronze writing. Another early form, 朙, has 月 and window 囧, the latter also phonetic. Eye-plus-moon identification is uncertain; some later eye or field shapes are explained as corruptions.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 明

evidence.text: Mandarin reading: jiǒng. The entry also preserves an ancient report that it was read like 明, without specifying a modern or reconstructed ancient syllable for that report.
evidence.title: 囧 — Mandarin pronunciation

evidence.text: The table identifies 囧 *k-mraŋʔ as Old Chinese in Baxter–Sagart system 1.1 (2014). For 囧 it additionally notes dialectal *k.mr- > *kʷr-.
evidence.title: 囧 — Old Chinese pronunciation

evidence.text: The table identifies 明 *mraŋ as Old Chinese in Baxter–Sagart system 1.1 (2014).
